pictures.author: R Prazeres
pictures.observed: Two white timber wings raised on slender grey stone columns with moulded bases/capitals; glazed left hall with oval upper tracery, taller right room with rectangular lower sashes and ornamental arched upper windows/pilasters/panelled spandrels. Shallow lead hips/broad pale soffits/finials, central stone stair/round portal, sparse grey end wall and rough stone behind the open undercrofts.

pictures.author: Alexxx1979
pictures.observed: Garden-facing composition: two separate pale timber wings, connector/round stone entrance and long central stair between the elevated rooms. Three lower/tall upper windows on the right facade; wide lower glazing/oval upper band on the left. Native mosque/terrace/trees are independent.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Sofa/Terrace Pavilion: two elevated pale painted-timber wings on slender stone columns, different glazed-hall and ornamental-room window rhythms, two separate shallow lead hips with small finials, broad white soffits, raised panel/cornice work and central stone stair/round-arched entrance connector. Open undercrofts retain native ground. Do not include the independent Baghdad/Yerevan/Sofa Mosque, surrounding retaining precinct, copied interior art or furnishings.
